question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who is not sure about God’s existence
solution:
The correct answer is '**Agnostic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Agnostic**'.
 
• It means a person who is not sure if God exists or not'. (ईश्‍वर की सत्ता के विषय में संशय रखने वाला; संशयवादी, अज्ञेयवादी)
 
 
• *Example: I remain myself an unbeliever, an **agnostic**, but not an atheist on the subject.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Agnostic.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Anchor**: a heavy metal object at the end of a chain that you drop into the water from a boat in order to stop the boat moving. (ज़ंजीर के अन्त में लगी धातु की भारी वस्तु जिसे नाव से पानी में गिराकर नाव को चलने से रोका जाता है; लंगर )
 
• **Pantheist**: someone who believes in many or all gods. (कोई है जो कई या सभी देवताओं में विश्वास करता है)
 
• **Haggard**: (used about a person) looking tired or worried. [(व्‍यक्ति) देखने में थका हुआ और चिंतित]
